Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Final Assembly: assemble the representative bicycle using the checked subassemblies and supplied components. A historical work order records this work center for product 984; the detailed sequence below is inferred.<step>Support <material>LL Mountain Frame - Silver, 40 (Product Number FR-M21S-40)</material> in an assumed <tool>assembly stand</tool>. Fit <material>LL Headset (Product Number HS-0296)</material> at the frame's steering interface; the fork is part of the frame's nested BOM.</step><step>Fit <material>LL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M243)</material> and <material>LL Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M198)</material> to the supported frame. See the schematic in illustration <diag>100231</diag>.</step><step>Fit <material>LL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-7421)</material> at the bottom-bracket interface, followed by <material>LL Crankset (Product Number CS-4759)</material> and the supplied 1 EA <material>LL Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M282)</material>, using assumed <tool>appropriate hand tools</tool>.</step><step>Position <material>LL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M423)</material> at the fork and <material>LL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M423)</material> at the rear of the frame, as shown in illustration <diag>100231</diag>. Fit them using the available interfaces.</step><step>Fit <material>Front Derailleur (Product Number FD-2342)</material> and <material>Rear Derailleur (Product Number RD-2308)</material> at their respective drivetrain positions, then fit <material>Chain (Product Number CH-0234)</material> and check its movement by hand.</step><step>Fit <material>Front Brakes (Product Number FB-9873)</material> and <material>Rear Brakes (Product Number RB-9231)</material> at their respective wheel positions. Check visible alignment and clearance.</step><step>Inspect the assembled demonstration for visible damage, wheel rotation and steering movement. Identify missing control or attachment details for authorized review rather than assuming the bicycle is ready to ride.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: Tooling, processes, routing beyond the historical evidence, and all times are demo estimates.
The historical record places product 984 at Final Assembly, location 60; the preceding Subassembly stop at location 50 is inferred, not a documented routing.
Manufactured subassemblies are assumed to arrive complete. Purchased components are received ready for fitting; their manufacture is outside this draft.
Each direct component has a source quantity of 1 EA. In particular, the pedal is listed as 1 EA; no additional pedal is assumed.

The snapshot does not identify all control or attachment details. The demonstration does not establish a ride-ready bicycle; actual assembly and safety verification require authorized product-specific procedures.
variantNotes: The representative Silver, 40 uses frame 944, FR-M21S-40. Silver sizes 42, 44, 48 and 52 instead use frames 917 (FR-M21S-42), 918 (FR-M21S-44), 919 (FR-M21S-48) and 920 (FR-M21S-52), respectively.

Black sizes 40, 42, 44, 48 and 52 use frames 943 (FR-M21B-40), 924 (FR-M21B-42), 925 (FR-M21B-44), 926 (FR-M21B-48) and 927 (FR-M21B-52), respectively. Do not substitute the representative silver frame.

All listed variants use the same front wheel 815 and rear wheel 823 and the same remaining direct components, each at 1 EA. Variant-specific frame finishing details are not supplied and are not inferred.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.
Standardized work-center hand-off notes and separated preparation time from hands-on labor.
Reformatted shop-floor copies for clearer numbered steps and consolidated inspection comments.
Reordered the Chain receiving check ahead of kit staging; added a missing-part hold point.
Clarified identification of Rear Derailleur; retained the source part number in the point-of-use checklist.
Released the illustrated workstation edition: Frame and wheel placement. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100231.title: Frame and wheel placement
guidance: Support LL Mountain Frame - Silver, 40 (Product Number FR-M21S-40) in an assumed assembly stand. Fit LL Headset (Product Number HS-0296) at the frame's steering interface; the fork is part of the frame's nested BOM.
Fit LL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M243) and LL Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M198) to the supported frame. See the schematic in illustration 100231.

Position LL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M423) at the fork and LL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M423) at the rear of the frame, as shown in illustration 100231. Fit them using the available interfaces.
